extracted.intended_audience: companies, registrants, importers, downstream users, manufacturers, regulators and other stakeholders with responsibilities or interests under EU chemicals legislation (REACH/CLP/BPR/etc.)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference and guidance page listing the REACH Regulation, implementing legislation, related regulations, and the regulatory processes (registration, evaluation, authorisation, restriction) and practical guidance for companies and stakeholders to comply with EU chemicals law.

rubrics_metrics.name: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006
rubrics_metrics.description: Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 concerning the Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH), establishing a European Chemicals Agency, amending and repealing earlier directives and regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as the primary legal framework for registration, evaluation, authorisation and restriction of chemicals in the EU; the consolidated/regulatory text is the normative legal source.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidated versions vs. legal value
rubrics_metrics.description: Consolidated versions of regulations incorporate amendments and corrigenda for documentary purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The consolidated text 'has no legal value' and for legal purposes one must refer to the texts published in the Official Journal of the European Union.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities and obligations related to registering substances manufactured or imported in the EU under REACH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes dossier submission, information requirements and updating registrations when duties arise (see implementing regulation on duties to update registrations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Substance identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Processes and criteria for identifying substances subject to REACH obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance available to determine substance identity as part of registration and other regulatory actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research and development (PPORD) provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions for research and development (Perpetual Product-Oriented Research and Development) under REACH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PPORD has specific rules and reporting obligations distinct from commercial registration; guidance is available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data sharing obligations and joint submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on joint submission of data, data-sharing among registrants and related implementing legislation (e.g., Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2016/9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes procedures for joint submissions, data-sharing disputes, and implementing regulations governing these processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data sharing disputes and inquiry mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for resolving disputes about data sharing among registrants and for making inquiries under REACH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ECHA provides processes and tools to address and resolve disputes and to facilitate inquiry handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The specific information that must be provided in dossiers for substances (data requirements under REACH).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes technical, toxicological, ecotoxicological and exposure information; detailed guidance documents exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chemical Safety Report (CSR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to prepare a Chemical Safety Report where applicable, documenting hazard assessment and risk management measures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes exposure scenario roadmap and links to use maps; CSR content and format are governed by REACH information requirements and guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exposure scenario roadmap and use maps
rubrics_metrics.description: Tools and documentation to map uses of a substance and to describe exposure scenarios for risk assessment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to structure the CSR and to communicate safe use conditions in downstream supply chain documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publishing information from dossiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and procedures about what information from submitted dossiers is made publicly available and how.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ECHA provides mechanisms to publish non-confidential dossier information while protecting valid confidentiality claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revocation and invalidity of registration decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for revoking or declaring invalid registration decisions under REACH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes legal and procedural grounds for revocation or invalidity and ECHA/competent authority roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation process (Dossier and Substance Evaluation)
rubrics_metrics.description: The evaluation procedures applied by authorities to check compliance of dossiers and to evaluate substances (including CoRAP priorities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers actors involved, deadline-setting in evaluation decisions, dossier evaluation, compliance checks, and examination of testing proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of testing proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of proposed testing on substances to ensure tests are necessary and that animal testing is minimized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of dossier evaluation; testing proposals are scrutinised for necessity and alternatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community Rolling Action Plan (CoRAP) / Substance Evaluation priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Mechanism for prioritising substances for substance evaluation across Member States (CoRAP listing and updates).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes processes for updates, what happens after substance evaluation, and publication of progress reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommendations to registrants
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and recommendations issued by ECHA to registrants following evaluations or regulatory developments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include corrective actions, additional data requests or process changes to ensure compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorisation process
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and criteria for authorising substances of very high concern for specific uses (including identification of SVHCs and the Authorisation List).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers candidate identification, recommendations for inclusion in the Authorisation List, applications for authorisation, and documentation of downstream uses covered by granted authorisations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification of Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and process for identifying SVHCs (e.g., CMRs, PBT, vPvB, endocrine disruptors) and listing them on the Candidate List.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on obligations triggered by Candidate List inclusion and on the identification workflow (MSC draft recommendations, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Candidate List obligations and communication in the supply chain
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligations arising when a substance is on the Candidate List, including communication and information duties down the supply chain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes duties to notify ECHA for articles, provide information to recipients and consumers, and update safety data sheets where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommendation for inclusion in the Authorisation List
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive criteria used in drafting recommendations to include substances in Annex XIV (Authorisation List).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes draft recommendations prepared by MSC and consultation processes prior to listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: The formal process to restrict or ban substances or specific uses under REACH, including preparation of restriction proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers consultation steps, the roles of RAC and SEAC, ECHA activities on restrictions, and publication of restriction intentions and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparation of a restriction proposal and consultations
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on preparing restriction dossiers and conducting public consultations to gather evidence and stakeholder input.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ECHA organises consultations to gather the widest possible range of scientific information for regulatory processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information on restricted substances
rubrics_metrics.description: Records and publications describing substances subject to restrictions and the scope of those restrictions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes registries of restriction intentions until outcome and lists of substances restricted under REACH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication in the supply chain and extended safety data sheets
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for providing safety information along the supply chain, including extended safety data sheets for worker protection and exposure scenarios.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance and templates are provided for consistent communication between manufacturers, importers, distributors and downstream users.

rubrics_metrics.name: Downstream user responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Duties and obligations of downstream users under REACH, including how to assess uses, apply risk management measures and communicate with suppliers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate guidance pages exist for downstream users, formulators, and other supply-chain roles (manufacturers, importers, only representatives, distributors).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of substances in articles
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligation to notify ECHA about articles containing Candidate List substances above concentration thresholds when certain conditions are met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on how to notify and the obligations for articles is provided; related to Candidate List and communication duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternatives to animal testing under REACH
rubrics_metrics.description: Expectation to use alternative methods and strategies to avoid unnecessary animal testing and to follow prescribed test methods regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes the Test Methods Regulation (EC No 440/2008) and amendments updating accepted test methods; ECHA promotes alternatives and provides guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Test Methods Regulation and technical adaptations
rubrics_metrics.description: Regulation laying down accepted test methods pursuant to REACH, with consolidated text and technical amendments (e.g., Commission Regulation (EC) No 440/2008 and later amendments).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consolidated text is documentary; amendments (such as Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/464) adapt the annex for technical progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees and charges (Fee Regulation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on fees and charges payable to the European Chemicals Agency under REACH, set out in the Fee Regulation (EC No 340/2008) and amendments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consolidated versions are for documentary purposes; legal reference is the Official Journal. Amendments (e.g., 2025 amendment) update fee arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enforcement and national inspectorates
rubrics_metrics.description: Framework for enforcement of REACH obligations, including the role of national inspectorates and cooperation mechanisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes guidance on enforcement practices and contacts for national authorities tasked with compliance checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nanomaterials and sectoral approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Special considerations and expert group activities related to nanomaterials and sector-specific approaches (e.g., Metals and Inorganics Sectoral Approach).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ECHA hosts expert groups and sectoral initiatives to assess regulatory needs and specific substance classes.

rubrics_metrics.name: PBT and vPvB assessment and management
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and processes for assessing persistent, bioaccumulative and toxic (PBT) or very persistent and very bioaccumulative (vPvB) substances and managing them under REACH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes PBT expert groups, assessment methods and management recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Endocrine disruptor assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment framework for endocrine-disrupting properties of substances and related expert group activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ECHA maintains an Endocrine Disruptor Expert Group and provides meeting reports and lists of participants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessment of regulatory needs and cooperation with stakeholders
rubrics_metrics.description: Processes for assessing where regulatory action is needed and cooperating with authorities, stakeholders and industry groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes forums like RIME+, expert groups, collaborations (e.g., ECHA-CEFIC), and public consultations to inform regulatory decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management and supporting activities (expert groups, working groups)
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting structures such as expert groups (PBT, endocrine disruptors, exposure expert groups) and working groups that provide technical input and guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ECHA lists group participants, meeting dates and reports to ensure transparency and stakeholder involvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information resources and support for companies
rubrics_metrics.description: ECHA provides guidance documents, formats and templates, webinars, helpdesks, and targeted SME resources to help companies comply with REACH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes dossier submission tools, Q&As, support pages and contact points for practical assistance.
